settings.label: Who We Are
settings.heading: The Leading Manufacturer Of Advanced Surgical Instruments
settings.text:
AVM Healthcare Products Pvt. Ltd. is a New Delhi–based manufacturer and supplier of surgical instruments and medical devices, engaged in the design, development, innovation, production and sales across Neurosurgery, Cranio Surgery, Plastic Surgery, implants, Spinal Surgery, Cardiovascular, Gynaecology, ENT, Orthopaedics, and more.

We produce AVM indigenous products in German collaboration and ANI products made in Germany, supplying to premier institutes of India and exporting to overseas markets.

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.text: To provide world-class instruments for the benefit of mankind. Our motto is to continuously evolve our product range to meet the dynamic requirements of surgical users.

settings.title: Our Motive
settings.text: Surgeon priority with hundred percent satisfactory installations worldwide. Offering complete solutions from idea conceptualisation and product design to product launch, including validation with Govt. and Non-Govt. bodies under OEM arrangements.

settings.title: German Collaboration
settings.text: AVM produces indigenous products in collaboration with German engineering standards, and ANI products made in Germany — combining the best of Indian manufacturing with European precision.

settings.label: Our Instruments

settings.text: Neurosurgery, Cardiovascular, Thoracic, Oncosurgery, Orthopaedics, G.I. Surgery, Urology — and other Super Specialities.
Based in Germany? Our products are also available through ANI Instruments — our German precision partner.

settings.question: Do You Supply To Individual Doctors Or Only Institutions?
settings.answer: We primarily supply to hospitals, surgical centres, government procurement agencies, and distributors. Individual practitioners may contact us to discuss their requirements directly.

settings.question: How Can I Request A Product Catalogue?
settings.answer: You can request our full product catalogue through the Request Catalogue page on this website. Our team will send it to your inbox within one business day.

settings.question: Do You Export Outside India?
settings.answer: Yes. We export to international markets and have an established presence through our German partner, ANI Medizintechnik GmbH, based in Hamburg.

settings.question: Are Your Products CE And ISO Certified?
settings.answer: Yes. All AVM products are CE certified, ISO compliant, and FDA registered. Quality is monitored at every stage of manufacturing.

settings.question: Can Instruments Be Customised To Specific Requirements?
settings.answer: Absolutely. We offer customisation based on the specific needs of individual surgeons and institutions — from dimensions to materials and finishes.

settings.question: What Is Your Delivery Timeline?
settings.answer: Delivery timelines vary based on product and location. Please contact us directly at info@avmhealthcare.com for specific delivery information.

settings.question: How Do I Get After-Sales Service And Support?
settings.answer: We offer 24×7 service support. Contact our team at info@avmhealthcare.com or call our New Delhi office for assistance.

settings.question: Do You Work With Government Hospitals?
settings.answer: Yes. We supply to government institutions across India through both direct supply agreements and government procurement programs.
